title: Convolutional Sequence to Sequence Learning
authors: J. Gehring, M. Auli, D. Grangier, D. Yarats, Y. Dauphin
before: Sequence models were recurrent, and recurrence forced sequential computation.
problem: Training could not be parallelised across positions, so it was slow.
breakthrough: Replace recurrence with stacked convolutions plus attention at every layer.
why: The road not taken. It showed removing recurrence was possible months before the Transformer did it differently.
next: The Transformer cited it and then overtook it comprehensively.
inherits: Mostly historical: it marks that parallelism, not attention alone, was the prize.
